item.description:
New • The Claude and Codex plan-limit bars now show a tick where an even pace would be by now, and say "on pace" or "ahead of pace". A bar turns amber when you're using the allowance faster than the clock and less than half is left
Improved • Updates now install on their own once Actvt is out of sight, instead of waiting for you to quit it. Actvt comes back in the menu bar with its window closed, and the app you were using stays in front • While an agent works and Actvt's window is hidden, Actvt uses about a third less CPU
Fixed • In the session list, a row's time now always matches its date header: a session from yesterday afternoon reads "yesterday", not "20 hr ago", and one from two days ago no longer reads "yesterday"

Improved • Codex sessions now show the tools they actually ran (shell commands, file edits, MCP tools, web searches, images) and how many of them failed. Before, a session in Codex's code mode counted every call as one wrapper tool, with no errors • VoiceOver now reads icon-only buttons by what they do, such as "Overview", instead of their symbol's name ("Bar Chart With An X Axis")
Fixed • The ⌥T shortcuts now work from any app and with Actvt's window closed: R and M take effect at once, and "." or a section key brings the window back • In a transcript, ⌥↓ and ⌥↑ now step through every turn instead of stopping after one, and ⌘↑ goes to the first turn again • Pins and session names are no longer erased when a session folder is briefly unreadable, for example an external drive that isn't mounted • An agent re-run in a loop now notifies when each run finishes, not about one run in three • Notifications from a remote machine keep arriving after that machine's notification queue starts over (update actvt-cli on the remote machine too) • In the session list, each row now sits under the date header that matches the time it shows

Improved • Long sessions now open on their latest turns. Scroll to the top, or press ⌘↑ at the first turn shown, to page back through earlier ones. Before, a session over 50 MB showed only its oldest turns and ended in "Transcript truncated" • Actvt uses less CPU while its window is hidden: background samples no longer redraw a window nobody can see
Fixed • Long ids and millisecond timestamps in tool output are no longer flagged and masked as card numbers. A card number now needs a real card network's prefix, and existing sessions are re-scanned on the first launch • A transcript that changed within a second of Actvt reading it is now picked up, so its cost, tokens, search and sensitive-data counts no longer stay short • MCP's `system_uptime` and the diagnostics export now report how long this run of Actvt has been up, and its real memory footprint (the figure Activity Monitor shows)
